Clean pass, three caveats. (1) ENGLISH FALLBACK: the study administered a Chinese questionnaire ('We translated the scales from English to Chinese and adapted the context to the participants' work settings'; 'The survey instruments were first translated from English to Chinese using a forward-backward translation method'), but no Chinese wording for these five items is recoverable from either place recoverability is scoped to. S1 File (the only Supporting Information file; sha256 a2b8f618be9d2de7bb31c113709bfe87ddd7dd682e5dc2816359a74d1444c343) is a single-sheet .xlsx whose header row carries English wording for every questionnaire item 17-42 except item 35 ('35、我可以向同事倾诉心声', which belongs to the workplace_friendship block and is not shipped in this table); the paper body prints no items at all for this block. So the English ships in the base fields per the 2026-09-01 fallback, language=Chinese marks the administration, and the _translated columns are omitted. (2) SCALE UNNAMED: the paper's Measures section describes only the five constructs it analyses (red tape, negative emotions, surface acting, deep acting, customer orientation) and never names a source scale, citation or alpha for the job-dissatisfaction block, so the `instrument` field names it descriptively rather than claiming a published instrument. Step 3b check passes on content: all five items are unambiguously job dissatisfaction ('I do not enjoy my job; I just invest time to get paid', 'My job feels more like a chore or a burden'), matching the table name and the dictionary Description. (3) MIDPOINTS UNLABELLED: the paper states 'All items were rated on a five-point Likert scale, with "1" to "5" representing five levels from "strongly disagree" to "strongly agree"' and labels nothing between, so option_text is populated at resp=1 and resp=5 only and left blank at 2/3/4 rather than padded. RESP AXIS NEEDS NO INFERENCE: data/qiang_2025_red_tape.py applies pd.to_numeric to the raw cells with no recode, and the raw cells are already integers 1-5, so the live resp values ARE the source values. RIGHTS: no restriction quotable. The paper names no rights holder for this block, nothing in instrument_rights_register.csv matches, and the wording is published in a CC BY 4.0 PLOS ONE Supporting Information file; silence is permission, so extraction proceeded. DATA OBSERVATION (about the response table, not the text): the five items split into two clusters that barely relate -- diss1/diss3/diss5 intercorrelate r=0.67-0.73 and diss2/diss4 correlate r=0.56, but across the two groups r runs -0.12 to +0.04, computed on the 396 complete raw rows. The whole deposit shows an unusual near-uniform positive correlation among unrelated blocks (job dissatisfaction mean correlates +0.84 with the job performance mean and +0.84 with red tape), so this looks like a property of the response data rather than of the item-to-text mapping, which is header-based and carries no inference. Flagged for a human eye on the data, not on the item text. Per-item coverage: n=396 with zero missing for each of the five source columns, and every item uses all five levels.
